exposure: low middle cerebral artery pulsatility index
outcome: cesarean and instrumental deliveries due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR)
cohort: 246 low-risk, singleton pregnancies at term with appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) fetuses
finding: Fetal growth velocity, EFW between 10 and 25th percentiles (EFWQ1), and abnormal CPR improves prediction of unplanned CS due to NRFHR among term AGA fetuses.
